findings.desc: CHK-002 edge intent says a project with a pre-existing real src directory should keep scanRoot=src, but the recorded evidence for that intent is only npm run build plus a logic note against packages/main/src/cli-init.ts:413-421. scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs:153-305 never creates a temp repo with an existing src before init, so this runtime branch is not actually exercised. Compile success is not sufficient evidence for the pre-existing-src detection path.

packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:360,364 changes fixture schema typing (z.record signature) even though B-6c80 is scoped to koala init behavior. Keep this story focused on init or move the cli-engine hunk into its own story/commit so concept review stays narrow.
README entrypoint smoke只覆盖本地 node entrypoint；当前 bare `koala init --help` 仍显示默认生成 src/core/src/shells/tests 的旧文案，用户路径与 README/本地 dist 帮助不一致。

scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs:145-150 and 284-295 now cover the repo-local init --help contract and the pre-existing src runtime branch, so F-001's missing smoke path is fixed. However the verification evidence has not been refreshed for the current HEAD: koala validate --story=B-6c80 --json on 68f8ddcd reports 9 stale entries / 6 required missing because every CHK-001..003 evidence record still points at older head hashes (71ccb3d or aed3351). WHY: test-coverage review requires current-head evidence, and without verification_evidence_refresh_stale plus a fresh validate pass this story is still blocked at REVIEW.

koala validate --channel --story=B-6c80 --json fails on HEAD: normal channel requires implementer commits for non-metadata changes. Offenders are 066ba4a (Harmonygo — fix init smoke review gaps) touching README.md and scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs, and aed3351 (Harmonygo — fix init starter opt-in) touching packages/main/src/cli-init.ts, packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts, README.md, and scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs. Only metadata-only koala:* commits may be non-implementer in normal channel, so this bypasses the channel gate. Fix by replaying the code changes through koala-implementer commits (or marking every CHK as Owner=main-agent in plan.md before implementation if that exemption is intentional), then rerun koala validate --channel --story=B-6c80 --json.
